bullets.title: Fed hike risk rising: August labor data hawkish, watch Core PCE
bullets.body: August E/Pop recovery reversed the dovish July signal, with older-worker employment ratios rebounding sharply. Analyst flags rate hike probability rises materially if Core PCE tracks at 15 bps or above; CPI Friday and Wednesday import prices are the key inputs ahead of the Sept 17 FOMC.

bullets.title: AMZN: Cargo plane crash at Miami airport, five killed
bullets.body: An Amazon Boeing 767-300 cargo plane overran the Miami runway Sunday, killing at least five and forcing runway closures. Operational and reputational overhang to watch; no financial guidance impact cited yet.

bullets.title: MSFT/OpenAI: Copyright lawsuit filed by Seattle Times and Newsday over AI training data
bullets.body: The Seattle Times and Newsday sued OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement, alleging their journalism was used without permission to train AI models. Adds to the growing litigation stack around AI training data exposure for MSFT.

bullets.title: Gaming sector: CHDN reiterated Best Idea Long; PENN upgraded; MGM/RRR downgraded
bullets.body: Hedgeye GLL updates positions across gaming: CHDN stays Best Idea Long, PENN upgraded to Long Bias from Neutral, while RRR moves to Short Bias and MGM is cut from Best Idea to Long Bias. Macau GGR ran -1% YoY, with 2H growth now expected at ~low-single-digits, half of prior forecast; US hotel RevPAR also showing softening demand.
